claim: A Firehose stream in one Region cannot deliver data into an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain VPC destination in a different Region: the Firehose stream and the destination OpenSearch Service domain need to be in the same Region.

values.display: need to be in the same region

qualifiers.scope: Amazon OpenSearch Service domain VPC destination

evidence.quote: No, your Firehose stream and destination Amazon OpenSearch Service domain need to be in the same region.
evidence.heading: Can I use a Firehose stream in one region to deliver my data into an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain VPC destination in a different region?
